coldOpen.headline: This one is built around you.
coldOpen.body: A short film with a few questions in it. Answer them and we build your guide from what you tell us.

chapter1.title: What clipping is
chapter1.lead: Why short clips move attention, and why we do it.

plain.title: What clipping is
plain.lead: Why short clips move attention, and why we do it.

lead.buyer: You set the goal. We run the network.
lead.clipper: You pick the campaign. You post. You get paid for counted views.

buyer.title: Brief and strategy
buyer.body: You work with our team to set your niche, your content, the rate per 1,000 views and the budget.

buyer.title: Clippers activate
buyer.body: Your campaign goes live to the network. Clippers choose it based on fit and audience.

buyer.title: Review before it counts
buyer.body: Every post is checked before it counts, and every approved post links to its source.

buyer.title: Pay for counted views
buyer.body: You pay only for views that pass review. Posts keep working after the budget is spent.

clipper.title: Join
clipper.body: Join the network and see the campaigns that are live right now.

clipper.title: Pick a campaign
clipper.body: Choose a campaign that fits your niche and your audience. Each one has its own brief and its own rate.

clipper.title: Post
clipper.body: Make your clips and post them on your own accounts. Every post is checked before it counts.

clipper.title: Get paid for counted views
clipper.body: You get paid for the views that pass review, at the rate the campaign sets.

gate.headline: Your guide is ready to build.
gate.body: Tell us where to send it. We build it from your answers and email it to you in a few minutes.
gate.plainBody: Tell us who you are and where to send it. We email it to you in a few minutes.

consent.text: Send me my guide and follow-up emails from Maison d’Élites, and allow analytics and ad measurement on this page. I can unsubscribe at any time.

book.body: Choose a slot that works for you. We will go through your plan on the call.

soft.headline: Want to talk numbers?
soft.body: Reply to the guide email with a rough budget and we will tell you what it can do. Or add a number here.
